title: Reflection of a single constant chart under coefficient-sized comparison
statement: Let X be any scheme, A any commutative ring in max(v,u+1), F an A-module sheaf on the coefficient-sized etale site, V an object of that site, and M an A-module in the same coefficient universe. Use the comparison inverse image P and inclusion i of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], with the coefficient-sized models of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], and constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. An isomorphism (P F).over i(V) ≅ constant M on the pro-etale slice implies that F.over V ≅ constant M on the etale slice. There is no covering hypothesis, no finite generation or finite presentation hypothesis on M, and no Noetherian hypothesis on A.

source.place: Tag 099T, lemma-fully-faithful; Tag 099Y, lemma-compare-locally-constant, localization and descent of constant charts

proof.text: The coefficient-sized comparison unit is invertible. Restrict its underlying presheaf map along AsSmall.up and AffineEtale.Spec; these two dense-subsite restriction functors are fully faithful and hence reflect isomorphisms. The unit is the composite of the left-Kan-extension unit and the restriction of the pro-etale sheafification unit. Full faithfulness of the inclusion makes the Kan unit invertible. For an affine etale object W, use the constant presentation indexed by PUnit, with vertex W and identity projection maps, in the coefficient presentation-sheafification theorem. Its vertex conclusion makes the second factor invertible. This proves invertibility on the affine etale basis and hence on all etale sheaves.

Let P and R be the comparison inverse and direct images. The inclusion preserves terminal objects. Compose the constant-sheaf adjunction on the etale site with P left adjoint to R. The right adjoint is terminal evaluation on the pro-etale site, since R is sectionwise restriction. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives k: P(constant_et M) isomorphic to constant_pro M. Compose the invertible unit at constant_et M with R(k), obtaining d: constant_et M isomorphic to R(constant_pro M).

Write R_V for direct image along Over.post of the inclusion. Sectionwise precomposition gives q_H: (R H).over V isomorphic to R_V(H.over i(V)); the underlying presheaf isomorphism is the identity. Restrict the invertible unit at F and then compose q_(P F) with R_V(e). The resulting target is R_V(constant_pro_slice M). Use the inverse constant-restriction isomorphism on the pro-etale site, then q_(constant_pro M) inverse, then the inverse restriction of d, then constant restriction on the etale site. This gives the desired isomorphism F.over V to constant_et_slice M. Continuity of Over.post follows from finite-limit preservation and cover preservation. All steps preserve M and the coefficient universe; none assumes V nonempty or M nonzero.

proof_origin.place: Tag 099T, lemma-fully-faithful, and Tag 099Y, comparison of constant charts; sectionwise direct image avoids transporting the slice sites. The unit is proved from the coefficient-sized presentation-sheafification theorem; the remaining argument is adjunction uniqueness and restriction of constant sheaves.

theorem coefficientComparison_constant_over_reflect (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A]
    (F : Sheaf (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
      (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A))
    (V : Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleSite.{u, v} X)
    (M : ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)
    (e : ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} X) (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
      (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)).obj F).over
        ((Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} X).obj V) ≅
      (constantSheaf ((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X).over
        ((Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} X).obj V))
        (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)).obj M) :
    Nonempty (F.over V ≅
      (constantSheaf ((Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X).over V)
        (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)).obj M)
